en: Welcome to the Blossom Road stable! Rhyhorn, Tauros and Rapidash are bred for speed here, and we race them round the track.
Any Pokémon big enough to carry a rider can run it. Hold the run button to push, press the button to jump the rocks, and lean into every turn.
Back on the track? Your best here is {number} points.
Care to race your own Pokémon against my three riders?
A good run! The track is hard on newcomers. Come back when you have found its rhythm.
Third place, and in front of the dust of the last of us. Take the stable's thanks for the ride.
Second place! You were close. The stable pays a little for a place like that.
First home! Not one of my riders has beaten that. Here is the stable's prize.
None of your Pokémon is big enough to carry a rider, or they are not fit to run. Come back with a sturdier one!
No hurry. The track isn't going anywhere. Come back whenever you like!
